packageRules.description: Routine updates still merge unattended, but RENOVATE performs the merge from inside its own run — `platformAutomerge` is deliberately false. GitHub's platform auto-merge is a per-PR flag any write-access account can arm, and the PR then merges itself later with nobody watching; these rules have no authority over it. On 2026-07-26 a bulk `gh pr merge --auto` sweep armed it across 8 repos and two actions/checkout MAJORS merged with zero reviews the next morning (reddoor-starter#77, reddoor-website#111) once Renovate's rebase cleared their conflicts. Routing merges through Renovate makes these packageRules the actual decision-maker. Renovate can only merge while running, so the repo cron IS the merge cadence (twice daily).

Never auto-merge packages that reshape the dependency graph (and thus pnpm hoisting). An @reddoorla/maintenance minor bump silently broke Netlify builds via an undeclared transitive sharp (fleet sharp fixes, 2026-06): GitHub Actions built green while Netlify failed. Require a human + a green Netlify deploy preview before these merge.

Majors need a human. This rule has been correct since the preset's first commit and was never the failure: Renovate has never armed auto-merge on a major. The 2026-07-26 incident (two actions/checkout majors merged with zero reviews — reddoor-starter#77, reddoor-website#111) came from a bulk `gh pr merge --auto` sweep by an operator/agent, which no Renovate config can block because platform auto-merge is a per-PR flag set outside Renovate. The real guard is that the fleet now disables platform auto-merge at the repository level (see the reddoor-maintenance `self-updating` recipe, which enforces allow_auto_merge=false and reports drift), so every merge goes through Renovate and lands on these rules. `platformAutomerge: false` here is belt-and-braces, not the mechanism.

Hold pnpm (packageManager) at 11.8.x: pnpm/action-setup's self-installer crashes bootstrapping any pnpm >=11.9 target ('self-installer exits with code 1' / 'Cannot use in operator to search for integrity in undefined'), breaking CI fleet-wide (2026-07). Only non-major pnpm bumps are held here; MAJOR pnpm updates and vulnerabilityAlerts still open PRs so the operator is notified for a manual fleetwide bump. Remove when action-setup/corepack reliably installs pnpm >=11.9.
